PPDG gives you 5 simple and fun putting games to help you focus and get in the reps. Play all 5 games and throw about 100 putts in around 20 minutes. 


Practice putting is necessary but boring. This app fixes that. Get in the practice reps so you can shave strokes and lower your scores. Do these drills often so you can putt with more confidence. Works indoors or at the practice basket. You can also play against your friends. 


PRACTICE

Chose 5 distances. Make one putt from each spot backing up after throw. Each putt made is 1 pt, double if you make them all (max 10 pts/round). First player to 21 wins. Must win by 2 at the end of each round. 


PRESSURE

Grab 5 putters and pick 3 distances. Start each round at the shortest distance from the basket. If you make the putt backup, if you miss move forward. Only putts made from the furthest distance score. Scoring is 3 pts each (max 9 pts/round). First player to 21 wins. Must win by 2 at the end of the round. 


PLAY

Alternate picking a different spot each round and make 2 putts each in a row. Players get 1 pt for 1 putt made and 3 pts for 2 putts made. First player to 21 wins. Must win by 2 at the end of the round. 


WINNING

Start with 5 putters at any distance and putt them all. Each missed putt is out of the game. Back up after each round and throw the remaining putters. Last person with a disc left wins! If everyone is out in the same round from the same spot, start again with all 5 putters.
